//go:build wasip3

// P3bind is F2's witness guest (Burroughs #1237; phase4/wasip3-f2.md). It calls the generated
// bindings directly and reports what it observed as a bitmask through wasi:cli/exit's
// exit-with-code, because stdout is F3's. Every property holding is exit 127.
//
//	0x01  argv is [anything, Token]: get-arguments, a list<string> placed through cabi_realloc
//	0x02  two monotonic-clock now readings do not decrease: one flat i64 result each
//	0x04  system-clock now's nanoseconds is below 1e9: a 16-byte record at alignment 8, through a
//	      return pointer, the u32 at offset 8
//	0x08  its seconds is after 2020-09-13 (1.6e9): the s64 at offset 0
//	0x10  get-random-bytes(16) returns 1 to 16 bytes, not all zero: a list<u8> through cabi_realloc
//	0x20  two get-random-u64 results differ
//	0x40  two get-insecure-seed results are equal: a tuple<u64, u64> through a return pointer
//
// Built from GOROOT, because the bindings are internal packages:
//
//	phase4/buildp3.sh src/internal/wasi/cmd/p3bind <out>/p3bind.wasm
//	wasmtime run <out>/p3bind.wasm f2-bindings-token
package main

import (
	"internal/wasi/generated/cli"
	"internal/wasi/generated/clocks"
	"internal/wasi/generated/random"
)

// Token is the argv[1] the 0x01 bit asks for. The readings run p3bind with it.
const Token = "f2-bindings-token"

func main() {
	var mask uint8

	if args := cli.GetArguments(); len(args) == 2 && args[1] == Token {
		mask |= 0x01
	}

	t1 := clocks.MonotonicClockNow()
	t2 := clocks.MonotonicClockNow()
	if t2 >= t1 {
		mask |= 0x02
	}

	now := clocks.SystemClockNow()
	if now.Nanoseconds < 1_000_000_000 {
		mask |= 0x04
	}
	if now.Seconds > 1_600_000_000 {
		mask |= 0x08
	}

	if b := random.GetRandomBytes(16); len(b) >= 1 && len(b) <= 16 {
		for _, c := range b {
			if c != 0 {
				mask |= 0x10
				break
			}
		}
	}

	if random.GetRandomU64() != random.GetRandomU64() {
		mask |= 0x20
	}

	if random.GetInsecureSeed() == random.GetInsecureSeed() {
		mask |= 0x40
	}

	cli.ExitWithCode(mask)
}
